Federated data governance is **a concept where you can define data governance standards centrally, while allowing the local domain teams to choose how they execute these standards.**. ## What is federated data governance? Federated data governance is **a concept where you can define data governance standards centrally, while allowing the local domain teams to choose how they execute these standards.**. ## What is the difference between federated and centralized data governance? Meanwhile, federated data governance is a flexible, scalable, and democratic approach where a central team oversees global rules, providing domains with adequate autonomy to oversee local governance. Besides defining the roles and responsibilities of the central group and domain teams, establishing communication points is equally crucial to the success of federated data governance. Federated data governance offers a flexible and scalable approach for organizations to manage data effectively while empowering domain teams with autonomy.

results.title: Systematic analysis of data governance frameworks and their relevance to data trusts | Management Review Quarterly | Springer Nature Link
results.content: # Systematic analysis of data governance frameworks and their relevance to data trusts. A unified framework outlining the procedures and methods necessary to adhere to data management standards is essential for effective Data Governance. Data Governance Frameworks serve as a guide to secure and trustworthy data exchange between different (legal) entities. However, there is a lack of knowledge in the literature concerning the assets and components of Data Governance Frameworks tailored for data intermediaries, including Data Trusts. Establishing a strong link between the components and assets gives an overview to practitioners on how the intended assets can be fulfilled properly with the corresponding component. This study conducts a systematic analysis of existing Data Governance Frameworks, identifying the crucial assets as well as components, and provides a mapping between them. The findings set a base that enables the development of a comprehensive Data Governance Framework tailored specifically for Data Trusts.
